answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the island of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the harbor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the saffron of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
